name: Mono-Red Burn (Pauper)
description: 60-card commons-only burn: tests 20 life, 4-of, suspend (Rift Bolt), landfall (Searing Blaze), alt sac costs (Fireblast/Shard Volley), tap-untap activation (Thermo-Alchemist), prowess-like trigger (Kiln Fiend), and pauper banlist enforcement (no Monastery Swiftspear — it's banned in pauper).
